text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
author: Mark Twain
sanduTip: Even opening a single flashcard today is a huge victory! Let's take that first step together~

text: Small disciplines repeated with consistency every day lead to great achievements.
author: John C. Maxwell
sanduTip: Consistency beats intensity every time! Just 10 minutes a day creates miracles.

text: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
author: Mahatma Gandhi
sanduTip: Curiosity keeps your mind shining bright! What would you like to explore today?

text: The expert in anything was once a beginner.
author: Helen Hayes
sanduTip: Never feel bad about getting an answer wrong. That's just your brain leveling up!

text: It always seems impossible until it is done.
author: Nelson Mandela
sanduTip: Whenever a big goal feels scary, break it into tiny bite-sized quests. You can do this!

text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
sanduTip: Don't wait for perfect conditions. Start right here, right now, and I'll cheer you on!

text: Take care of your body. It's the only place you have to live.
author: Jim Rohn
sanduTip: Remember to drink a glass of water and stretch those shoulders after long study sessions!

text: A one hour workout is 4% of your day. No excuses.
author: Unknown
sanduTip: Even a 15-minute brisk walk lifts your mood and clears mental fog!

text: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
author: Buddha
sanduTip: Take three deep breaths with me right now: Inhale peace... Exhale stress~

text: Quiet the mind, and the soul will speak.
author: Ma Jaya Sati Bhagavati
sanduTip: Give yourself permission to pause. Rest is an essential part of productive learning.

text: Action is the foundational key to all success.
author: Pablo Picasso
sanduTip: Thoughts become reality when you move your hands and take action!

text: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
author: Robert Collier
sanduTip: Our SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm will make sure those daily efforts stick forever!

text: You do not have to be extreme, just consistent.
author: Anonymous
sanduTip: A little stretch or a gentle stroll today keeps your streak alive and well!

text: The mind is everything. What you think you become.
author: Buddha
sanduTip: Tell yourself: 'I am capable, I am focused, and I am getting better every day!'

text: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
sanduTip: I already believe in you 100%! Now it's your turn to trust your potential.

text: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
author: Benjamin Franklin
sanduTip: Every new vocabulary word you master is a coin saved in your future treasure chest!

text: Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
author: Mahatma Gandhi
sanduTip: Push through the last minute of your workout! Your inner willpower is unmatched.

text: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
author: Albert Einstein
sanduTip: Hard quiz questions aren't traps; they're shining golden opportunities to grow!

text: Smile, breathe, and go slowly.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh
sanduTip: No need to rush through life. Breathe deeply and enjoy this very moment.

text: Continuous improvement is better than delayed perfection.
author: Mark Twain
sanduTip: Don't wait for your study notes to look flawless. Just start reviewing!

text: Your only limit is you.
author: Anonymous
sanduTip: Your body can handle almost anything; it's your mind you have to convince!

text: The roots of education are bitter, but the fruit is sweet.
author: Aristotle
sanduTip: Struggling with a difficult chapter? Just think of how sweet the mastery will taste!

text: Do something today that your future self will thank you for.
author: Sean Patrick Flanery
sanduTip: Your future self is smiling right now seeing the effort you put in today!

text: Energy flows where attention goes.
author: Tony Robbins
sanduTip: Close those extra browser tabs, put phone on silent, and let's enter flow mode!

text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
author: Japanese Proverb (七転び八起き)
sanduTip: Missed a goal or got a card wrong? Brush off the dust and try again with a smile!

text: Fitness is not about being better than someone else. It’s about being better than you were yesterday.
author: Khloe Kardashian
sanduTip: Compare yourself only to your past self. Every extra step is personal progress!

text: Education is the passport to the future.
author: Malcolm X
sanduTip: Pack your mental suitcase with knowledge, and go explore the world!

text: Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh
sanduTip: Feeling anxious? Put one hand on your chest and feel your steady heartbeat.

text: The harder you work for something, the greater you’ll feel when you achieve it.
author: Anonymous
sanduTip: I'll be right here with confetti ready when you reach your target milestone!

text: Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going.
author: Jim Ryun
sanduTip: Build small rituals: log your steps, review 5 cards, drink water. Easy habits win!

text: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
author: Benjamin Franklin
sanduTip: Active recall with flashcards involves your brain actively, locking knowledge in!

text: Be kind whenever possible. It is always possible.
author: Dalai Lama
sanduTip: Be kind to others, and don't forget to be kind and gentle with yourself too!

text: Hard days are what make you stronger.
author: Aly Raisman
sanduTip: When workout feels heavy, remind yourself that diamonds are made under pressure!

text: There are no shortcuts to any place worth going.
author: Beverly Sills
sanduTip: Enjoy the journey of learning step-by-step. Each lesson builds your character!

text: Don’t watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.
author: Sam Levenson
sanduTip: Tick-tock, tick-tock! Stay focused on your current task and watch magic happen.

text: Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
author: Anne Lamott
sanduTip: A quick 5-minute break away from screens refreshes your mental energy like new!

text: Sweat is just fat crying.
author: Unknown
sanduTip: Work up a healthy sweat today and celebrate your heart pumping with vitality!

text: Learning is never done without errors and defeat.
author: Vladimir Lenin
sanduTip: Every error points directly to what you're about to master next!

text: Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
author: Suzy Kassem
sanduTip: Silence that inner critic! You have so much brilliance waiting to shine.

text: The body achieves what the mind believes.
author: Napoleon Hill
sanduTip: Visualize completing your workout, and your legs will follow effortlessly!

text: Present moment, wonderful moment.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh
sanduTip: Yesterday is a memory, tomorrow is a dream. Right here is where your power lives.

text: Knowledge will bring you the opportunity to make a difference.
author: Claire Fagin
sanduTip: Your learning isn't just for you—it empowers you to uplift everyone around you!

text: Every strike brings me closer to the next home run.
author: Babe Ruth
sanduTip: Keep taking swings! Each attempt gets you calibrated for a big win.

text: If you want something you've never had, you must be willing to do something you've never done.
author: Thomas Jefferson
sanduTip: Try a new exercise or add 500 steps to your daily goal today!

text: Surrender to what is. Say 'yes' to life and see how life suddenly starts working for you.
author: Eckhart Tolle
sanduTip: Release tension in your jaw and shoulders. Accept this moment with grace.

text: The beautiful thing about learning is that no one can take it away from you.
author: B.B. King
sanduTip: What you store in your mind is yours forever. Keep filling it with gems!

text: You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
author: C.S. Lewis
sanduTip: Every sunrise is a fresh invitation to reinvent yourself. Let's make today count!

text: A champion is someone who gets up when they can't.
author: Jack Dempsey
sanduTip: When fatigue kicks in, that extra rep is where true champions are forged!

text: Simplicity is the keynote of all true elegance.
author: Coco Chanel
sanduTip: Declutter your study desk and your mind will immediately feel clearer!

text: Curiosity is the wick in the candle of learning.
author: William Arthur Ward
sanduTip: Ask 'why' and 'how' often. It keeps that flame of discovery dancing bright!

text: I can and I will. Watch me.
author: Carrie Green
sanduTip: Say this aloud with a confident posture! I'm cheering right behind you!

text: Look in the mirror. That’s your competition.
author: John Assaraf
sanduTip: Give your reflection a wink and say: 'Today, we're beating yesterday's record!'

text: In the midst of movement and chaos, keep stillness inside of you.
author: Deepak Chopra
sanduTip: Like the calm eye of a storm, maintain your inner center amid busy schedules.

text: The capacity to learn is a gift; the ability to learn is a skill; the willingness to learn is a choice.
author: Brian Herbert
sanduTip: Choosing to study today shows your amazing dedication. Keep shining!

text: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
author: Arthur Ashe
sanduTip: Perfection is the enemy of progress. Small, simple steps create masterpieces.

text: Good things come to those who sweat.
author: Anonymous
sanduTip: Grab your water bottle and let's get those endorphins flowing happily!

text: Nothing can bring you peace but yourself.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
sanduTip: You hold the master key to your tranquility. Choose calm over chaos today.

text: Study hard what interests you the most in the most undisciplined, irreverent and original manner possible.
author: Richard Feynman
sanduTip: Follow your fun and curiosity! Learning becomes effortless when you enjoy it.

text: Don't count the days, make the days count.
author: Muhammad Ali
sanduTip: Fill today with small victories, kind thoughts, and energized study sessions!

text: Respect your body when it asks for a break. Rest is work too.
author: Anonymous
sanduTip: Sleep restores muscles and consolidates memories in your brain. Sleep well tonight!

text: Within you there is a stillness and a sanctuary to which you can retreat at any time.
author: Hermann Hesse
sanduTip: Close your eyes for 30 seconds and find that peaceful sanctuary within.

text: Wisdom begins with wonder.
author: Socrates
sanduTip: Never stop wondering about the universe and how wondrous things are!

text: Great things never come from comfort zones.
author: Anonymous
sanduTip: Step slightly outside your comfort bubble today. That's where you grow!

text: Drink more water. Your brain and body will thank you.
author: SANDU
sanduTip: Hydration is your secret superpower for razor-sharp focus and stamina!

text: Breathe in love, breathe out gratitude.
author: SANDU
sanduTip: I am so grateful to be your companion on this study and wellness adventure~
